user.title: rbw
user.description: Connect to an rbw policy API using an mTLS client certificate. Certificate files stay on this Home Assistant host.

data.base_url: HTTPS API origin printed by rbw

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure rbw connection
reconfigure.description: Update mTLS certificate file paths for this rbw server. To change servers, remove this entry and add the new one.

data.base_url: HTTPS API origin printed by rbw

error.invalid_connection: The HTTPS URL or certificate files are invalid. Check the paths, PEM files, and key pair.

abort.already_configured: This rbw API URL is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The API origin identifies a different rbw server. Remove this entry and add the new server instead.

status_permission_required.title: rbw status permission required
status_permission_required.description: This client can reach the rbw API, but its separate status permission is missing. Run rbw api client list, then grant status access for the existing client and each intended account with rbw api status-grant <client-id> --account <account-name>.

status_unavailable.title: rbw status API unavailable
status_unavailable.description: Home Assistant could not read safe status from the rbw API. The status sensors will retry automatically.

api_unavailable.title: rbw API request failed
api_unavailable.description: A requested field could not be fetched. Retry the same request after the API or vault is available.

retry.title: Retry rbw request
retry.description: The requested value is discarded after checking that the request now succeeds.

error.still_unavailable: The API or vault is still unavailable. Try again later.
error.integration_unavailable: Reload the rbw integration, then retry.

abort.entry_not_found: The rbw config entry no longer exists.
abort.request_not_available: The failed request details are no longer available.
abort.request_not_retryable: The request now fails for a permanent reason. Check the item and field policy.
abort.credentials_need_update: The client certificate was rejected. Update the connection credentials.

client_certificate.title: rbw client certificate needs attention
client_certificate.description: Home Assistant could not authenticate with the rbw API. Update the client certificate or CA file paths.

abort.entry_not_found: The rbw config entry no longer exists.
abort.reconfigure_started: The rbw connection form was opened.

reauthentication_required.title: rbw item requires interactive unlock
reauthentication_required.description: This item requires the Bitwarden master password again. Remove its reprompt setting, or read it with the local interactive rbw client.

init.title: Handle item reprompt
init.description: Home Assistant cannot provide the master password prompt. Remove the item reprompt setting in Bitwarden, or use the local interactive rbw client, then retry to verify access.

manual_action.title: Retry item read
manual_action.description: After removing the reprompt setting, retry the request. The returned value is discarded.

error.reauthentication_required: The item still requires an interactive master password prompt.

abort.reauthentication_required: The item still requires an interactive master password prompt.

default_account_locked.title: rbw default vault is locked
default_account_locked.description: The default rbw account is locked. Enter the master password to unlock it and any follower accounts.

unlock.title: Unlock default rbw vault
unlock.description: Enter the master password for the default rbw account. The password is sent over mTLS to rbw-agent and is never stored by Home Assistant.

data_description.password: Bitwarden master password for the default rbw account

error.still_unavailable: The rbw API could not unlock the vault right now. Try again later.
error.integration_unavailable: Reload the rbw integration, then try again.

abort.entry_not_found: The rbw config entry no longer exists.
abort.credentials_need_update: The client certificate was rejected. Update the connection credentials.
abort.unlock_not_permitted: This rbw API client does not have permission for the default account.

access_request.title: {integration} asks to read an rbw item
access_request.description: The {integration} integration tried to read vault item {item} and was denied. Integrations can only read what you allow. Open this to allow it, or ignore it to keep denying it. Change this later in the rbw integration's options.

allow.title: Allow {integration}?
allow.description: Allow the {integration} integration to read vault item {item}? The rbw API's own field grants still apply.

abort.entry_missing: The rbw integration entry no longer exists.

init.title: Integration access
init.description: Integrations can only read the vault items you allow here; everything else is denied. Empty a row to revoke that integration's access.

data_description.add_integration: Submit to add its row. The form stays open, and nothing is saved until you submit without choosing one.
